skill.summary: Buy $WIR on TON -- the decentralized credit union token on TON.fun

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the buy-wir skill.

- Provides a comprehensive guide to buying $WIR, a decentralized credit union token on the TON blockchain.
- Offers step-by-step instructions for setting up a TON wallet, checking WIR prices, purchasing via browser or direct contract, and participating in Bot World games.
- Explains bonding curve mechanics and the benefits of holding WIR, including rank tiers and social perks.
- Describes how to exchange WIR for CRUST using The Bridge service.
- Includes all relevant links for wallets, exchanges, and Bot World resources.
